about: Skills of the mage fight, one list for every map: skills.json in the Nav folder (next to nav_view.html and the maps). Edited in nav_view.html, Settings > Skills; read by spot_farm_pack_nav.pas: the K mage lines of a .navgrid name skills of this list

types.TARGET: cast at the target (nuke, drain, debuff); range: the target must be this close
types.AOE: cast at the target from range, hits every mob within radius of it
types.SELF_AOE: no target: hits every mob within radius of us
